description: This file implements a hash table (lhash) in C, including functions for creation, deletion, insertion, retrieval, resizing, and iteration over hash elements.

classes.name: lhash_item_st
classes.description: Structure representing an item in the hash chain, containing data, a pointer to the next item, and a cached hash value.

classes.name: lhash_st
classes.description: Structure representing the hash table, including buckets, item count, comparison and hash functions, and internal state.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_new
methods.description: Creates a new hash table with specified hash and comparison functions.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a hash table.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_num_items
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a given element in the hash table.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_retrieve_key
methods.description: Retrieves data using a key and its hash value.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_insert
methods.description: Inserts data into the hash table, replacing existing data if equal.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_delete
methods.description: Deletes an element matching the data from the hash table.

methods.name: OPENSSL_lh_doall_arg
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements in the hash table with an argument.
